name: Contact the families on the overdue list and prompt them to pay
priorityReason: The overdue list is worth nothing until somebody acts on it, and an unlogged reminder is a chase nobody can see.

goal.capability: to remind the families who have not paid, and have every send recorded against the student
goal.outcome: families are prompted, and anyone opening the record afterwards sees exactly what they were told and when

secondaryActors.involvement: Receives the reminder on the contact held on the student record.
Reviews reminder activity and authorises a send above the configured threshold.

externalActors.involvement: Delivers the reminder and returns delivery status.
Delivers the reminder where SMS is the configured channel.

additional.description: Accounts pass a selection of families from the overdue list.

preconditions.condition: An overdue list has been produced and families have been selected from it.
An authenticated session exists and the acting user is Accounts.
A messaging channel is configured with balance, and a reminder template exists for it.
Each selected student holds a guardian contact for the chosen channel.

establishedBy.name: View and maintain the student record

postConditions: Each family selected has been sent a reminder carrying their own amount outstanding and their own due date.
Every send is logged against the student with its date, channel, template and delivery status, so anyone opening the record sees what the family was told.
Families on an approved installment plan that is being met were excluded, and none of them was contacted.
A family whose message failed is identifiable rather than assumed to have been reminded.
The invoice is unchanged. A reminder chases a debt; it does not alter it, waive it or charge for it.
Nothing was reported as delivered that the provider did not confirm.
Only Accounts sent it. Chasing a family for money is not something the rest of the school does.

dataFields.name: Recipients
dataFields.validation: The families selected from the overdue list. Students meeting an approved plan are excluded automatically (BR-3).

dataFields.name: Channel
dataFields.validation: Only channels the student record holds a contact for are offered (BR-5).

dataFields.name: Template
dataFields.validation: A saved reminder template. Required for a send to more than one family (BR-6).
dataFields.requiredWhen: More than one family is selected
dataFields.lookupSource: Reminder templates for the chosen channel

dataFields.name: Message body
dataFields.validation: Maximum 1000 characters. Used where Accounts write to one family directly.
dataFields.example: Assalam o alaikum, the September fee of PKR 4,000 was due on 10 September.

dataFields.name: Merge fields
dataFields.validation: Student name, amount outstanding and due date are filled per family from their own invoice, never typed (BR-2).

dataFields.name: Preview
dataFields.validation: The message as one named family will receive it, with the figures resolved.

dataFields.name: Outstanding at send
dataFields.validation: The amount outstanding at the moment of sending, held against the log entry so the message can be explained later (BR-9).

dataFields.name: Delivery status
dataFields.validation: Per recipient, as the provider reports it (BR-8).

entities.notes: One row per family per send, with the amount outstanding at the time. Append only.
Read for the amount outstanding and the due date. Never changed by a reminder (BR-10).
Read for the guardian contact the reminder is sent to.
Read to exclude families meeting an approved plan.
Held by the Messaging module with per-channel delivery status.
Read and resolved. Never edited from here.
Who sent what to whom, since this reaches families about money.

permissions.notes: The only role that sends a fee reminder. Sends up to the configured threshold without authorisation (BR-1, BR-7).

permissions.rowScope: Own branch; may switch per branch-scope.
permissions.notes: Reviews reminder activity and authorises a send above the threshold. Does not send.

permissions.rowScope: No access. Chasing a family for money is not a counter task.

businessRules.rule: Only Accounts send fee reminders. Chasing a family for money is not something the rest of the school does, and a reminder from the wrong person is worse than none.
Every reminder carries that family's own amount outstanding and their own due date, filled from their invoice. A figure typed into a message is a figure that can disagree with the ledger.
Families meeting an approved installment plan are excluded and cannot be re-added by selecting all. A family paying as agreed must not be chased.
A family who has missed an installment is not excluded, since a plan being kept and a plan being broken are different things.
A channel is offered only where the student record holds a contact for it.
A send to more than one family uses a template. Free text to many cannot be reviewed before it goes or reused afterwards.
A send above the configured threshold requires School Admin authorisation before it goes.
Delivery status is never reported optimistically. A reminder reads Queued until the provider says otherwise, so the school never believes a family was reminded when they were not.
The amount outstanding at the moment of sending is held against the log entry. Otherwise a message quoting PKR 4,000 becomes inexplicable once the family pays PKR 1,000.
A reminder changes nothing. It does not charge a late fee, alter the invoice or extend the due date.
Every send is logged against the student with its date, channel, template and delivery status, so anyone opening the record afterwards sees what the family was told.
A family already reminded within the configured interval is flagged, so the same family is not messaged three times in a week by three different runs.

transitions.condition: A read receipt is returned, where the channel supports it.
The provider rejects it, or there is no balance.

basicFlow.navigation: Login → Fee → Overdue fees → Select families
basicFlow.userAction: Opens the overdue list and selects the families to remind.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Excludes any family meeting an approved installment plan, and flags any reminded within the configured interval.

basicFlow.navigation: Overdue fees → Send fee reminders → Channel
basicFlow.systemResponse: Offers only channels the selected students hold a contact for.

basicFlow.navigation: Send fee reminders → Template or message
basicFlow.userAction: Selects a saved reminder template, or composes a message for a single family.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Requires a template where more than one family is selected.
Fills each family's own amount outstanding and due date from their invoice, and shows the preview for one named family.
Checks the count against the authorisation threshold, then queues one message per family to the contact on their record.
Logs the send against each student with its date, channel, template and the amount outstanding at the time.
Updates the delivery status against each log entry as the provider reports it.

alternateFlows.condition: The selection is above the authorisation threshold
alternateFlows.behaviour: Nothing is sent. The send holds for School Admin authorisation and the recipient list is frozen so it cannot grow while it waits (BR-7).

alternateFlows.condition: A family on a plan has missed an installment
alternateFlows.behaviour: They are not excluded and are reminded like anyone else, since a plan being broken is not a plan being met (BR-4).

alternateFlows.condition: One family needs a message of its own
alternateFlows.navigation: Overdue fees → Open student → Send reminder
alternateFlows.behaviour: Accounts write directly to that family rather than using a template, which is permitted for a single recipient (BR-6).

alternateFlows.condition: Some messages in the run fail
alternateFlows.behaviour: The rest are sent and the failures are listed per family with the reason, so a family whose message failed is identifiable rather than assumed to have been reminded.

alternateFlows.condition: A family was reminded two days ago
alternateFlows.behaviour: They are flagged in the selection, so the same family is not messaged three times in a week by three separate runs (BR-12).

alternateFlows.condition: A family says the reminder never arrived
alternateFlows.behaviour: The reminder is sent again with the current outstanding figure, and the resend is logged as its own entry.

exceptions.condition: A selected student holds no contact for any channel
exceptions.systemResponse: They are excluded from the send and listed, so the office knows the family cannot be reached.
exceptions.messageShown: 3 of the selected families have no contact on file and were not sent a reminder.

exceptions.condition: A merge field cannot be resolved
exceptions.systemResponse: The send is blocked rather than going out with a placeholder in place of an amount.
exceptions.messageShown: The template needs an amount outstanding, which one selected student does not have. Remove them or choose another template.

exceptions.condition: A template is not selected for a multi-family send
exceptions.messageShown: Select a template. Your own message can only be sent to one family at a time.

exceptions.condition: The selection is above the threshold
exceptions.systemResponse: Nothing is sent; the run goes for authorisation (BR-7).
exceptions.messageShown: This send needs School Admin approval. It has been sent for authorisation.

exceptions.condition: There is no messaging balance for the channel
exceptions.messageShown: There is no balance for this channel. Top up before sending.

exceptions.condition: A selected student's invoice has been paid since the list was run
exceptions.systemResponse: They are excluded from the send, so a family who has paid is not chased (BR-2).
exceptions.messageShown: 2 of the selected families have paid since the list was run and were not reminded.

exceptions.condition: A Staff user attempts to send a reminder
exceptions.messageShown: Only Accounts can send a fee reminder.

exceptions.systemResponse: The messages stay Queued and are retried. Nothing is reported as delivered (BR-8).
exceptions.messageShown: Reminders are queued and will send when the provider is reachable.

notifications.retry: Resend from the reminder log; each attempt is logged.

sideEffects.effect: The send appears in the school-wide sent-message log.
The last-reminded date on the student changes, which feeds the interval check on the next run.
Messaging balance for the channel is consumed.
The reminder history supports a later write-off, since a debt written off should show it was chased.

integrations.sends: The resolved reminder to the guardian contact on the student record
integrations.expects: Message id and delivery status callbacks
integrations.retry: 3 attempts with backoff, then marked Failed
integrations.onFailure: The reminder stays Queued and the log shows Queued rather than Sent, so the school never believes a family was reminded when they were not.

integrations.sends: The resolved reminder where SMS is the configured channel
integrations.onFailure: Marked Failed against that family only; the rest of the run is unaffected.

reports.name: Reminder log
reports.totals: Reminders sent, delivered and failed in the period

reports.name: Reminder effectiveness
reports.totals: Overall recovery within 7 days of a reminder

acceptanceCriteria.given: A family with PKR 4,000 outstanding since 10 September
acceptanceCriteria.then: the message carries their own amount and their own due date, filled from their invoice

acceptanceCriteria.given: A family meeting an approved installment plan
acceptanceCriteria.when: the whole overdue list is selected
acceptanceCriteria.then: they are excluded and cannot be re-added by selecting all

acceptanceCriteria.given: The same family after missing an installment
A family who paid after the list was run but before the send
acceptanceCriteria.then: they are excluded and listed, so a family who has paid is not chased

acceptanceCriteria.given: A selection larger than the authorisation threshold
acceptanceCriteria.then: nothing goes out, the list is frozen, and School Admin receives the authorisation request

acceptanceCriteria.given: A run of 40 where 3 numbers are unreachable
acceptanceCriteria.then: 37 are sent, the 3 are listed with their reason, and the run is not abandoned

acceptanceCriteria.given: A reminder sent to a family
acceptanceCriteria.then: the send appears with its date, channel, template, delivery status and the amount outstanding at the time

acceptanceCriteria.given: A reminder the provider has accepted but not confirmed
acceptanceCriteria.then: it reads Queued or Sent, never Delivered

acceptanceCriteria.given: A Staff user viewing the overdue list
acceptanceCriteria.when: they attempt to send a reminder
acceptanceCriteria.then: the action is refused and Accounts is named as the role that can

acceptanceCriteria.given: A reminder sent for an invoice of PKR 4,000
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is unchanged, with no late fee added and no due date extended

departures.requirement: A run to 500 families is queued within 10 seconds and delivered within the provider's rate limits, reporting progress while it runs.
Each family's amount is resolved at the moment of sending, not from the list as it was when it was run, so a family who has just paid is not chased.

What is the minimum interval before the same family may be reminded again?

conventionsApplied.name: session-and-authentication
conventionsApplied.rule: Every use case except the login use case assumes an authenticated session. Sign out is available on every screen. An expired or invalid session returns the user to the login screen with the message "Your session has ended. Please sign in again."

conventionsApplied.name: role-based-access
conventionsApplied.rule: Access is enforced server-side on every request, not only by hiding menu items. A request for a record outside the actor's permitted scope returns a 403 and the message "You do not have permission to view this record." A use case states additions and restrictions only.

conventionsApplied.name: branch-scope
conventionsApplied.rule: Every record carries a branch ID. Users see only their own branch unless the use case states otherwise. Super Admin, School Admin and Principal may switch branch from the header.

conventionsApplied.name: academic-session-scope
conventionsApplied.rule: Every academic record carries an academic session ID. Lists default to the current open session.

conventionsApplied.name: list-screens
conventionsApplied.rule: Every list supports search, column sort and page-size selection. Default page size 25; default sort is most recent first. Filters are applied before printing or exporting.

conventionsApplied.name: print-and-pdf
conventionsApplied.rule: Every report and list offers Print and Download as PDF, honouring the filters currently applied. Each output carries the school name, branch, academic session, report title, filter summary, generation timestamp and the name of the user who generated it.

conventionsApplied.name: audit-trail
conventionsApplied.rule: Every create, update, deactivation, approval and reversal writes to the audit log: actor, role, timestamp, record type, record ID, before and after values, and IP address. Audit entries are never editable.

conventionsApplied.name: validation-and-messages
conventionsApplied.rule: Field-level errors appear inline beneath the field on blur and on submit. Errors that block the whole action appear as a banner at the top of the form. Successful actions show a toast. No action succeeds silently.

conventionsApplied.name: money
conventionsApplied.rule: All monetary values are stored as fixed-point decimals in the smallest currency unit, never as floating point. Displayed as PKR with a thousands separator and two decimal places. Rounding is half-up at the line.

conventionsApplied.name: dates-times-numbers
conventionsApplied.rule: Dates display as DD-MM-YYYY; date and time as DD-MM-YYYY HH:mm in 24-hour form. Times are school-local. Phone numbers are stored in the registered mobile format.

conventionsApplied.name: language
conventionsApplied.rule: All user-visible strings come from a resource file. No hard-coded text in any screen.

conventionsApplied.name: screen-states
conventionsApplied.rule: Every list, dashboard tile and report defines four states: loading, empty, error and populated. The empty state names what is missing and links to the action that creates it.

conventionsApplied.name: bulk-actions
conventionsApplied.rule: Any bulk operation reports a per-row result, commits valid rows and lists rejected rows with the reason. A bulk action never fails as a whole because of one bad row.

conventionsApplied.name: notifications
conventionsApplied.rule: All outbound SMS, WhatsApp, email and push messages are sent through the Messaging module, recorded in the sent-message log with per-channel delivery status, and use a named template. Use cases reference the template; they do not embed message text.

conventionsApplied.name: default-performance-and-retention
conventionsApplied.rule: Unless a use case states otherwise: a screen loads within 2 seconds and a save completes within 2 seconds at 200 concurrent users; lists paginate above 100 rows; financial and student records are retained 7 years; audit and message logs 12 months; every screen is usable at a 360 px viewport. Fill the non-functional field only to depart from this.

conventionsApplied.name: default-trigger
conventionsApplied.rule: Unless a use case states otherwise, the trigger is: the user navigates to the screen and initiates the action. Fill the Triggers field only where a scheduled job, an event in another module, or an inbound external call also starts it.
